description: Defines the SurveyData class representing survey metadata, including identifiers, questions, components, and validity dates within the Fineract project.

classes.name: SurveyData
classes.description: A data model class for survey information, including properties like id, name, description, country code, questions, components, and validity period.

methods.name: SurveyData
methods.description: Default constructor for SurveyData.
